firm_data.firm_description: Meister Seelig & Fein PLLC is a New York City-based business law firm driven by entrepreneurial energy and focused on delivering results for our clients. They are a full-service commercial law firm with offices in New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, and California.
notable_facts: MSF has evolved into a premier business law firm.
The firm employs 95 people and has an annual revenue of $24.5M

email.subject: AI for Meister Seelig & Fein, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Mercedes,

As COO of a 75-attorney firm juggling hedge funds and real estate work across four states, you're managing complexity that most legal tech vendors simply don't understand. Meister Seelig & Fein's entrepreneurial DNA since 1994 means you likely want tools that keep pace with your ambition, not slow you down.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in LA to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
